summary_en: This phase I study tests gilteritinib, a drug already FDA approved for a type of leukemia, in people with stage IV ALK-positive non-small cell lung cancer who have progressed on other treatments. Gilteritinib is taken by mouth once daily on days 1 to 21 of each 21-day cycle, and cycles repeat if the disease does not progress and side effects are acceptable. The study looks at safety, side effects and the best dose; no separate outcome measure is stated.
summary_es: Este estudio de fase I evalúa gilteritinib, un medicamento que ya cuenta con aprobación de la FDA para un tipo de leucemia, en personas con cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas con ALK positivo en etapa IV que han progresado con otros tratamientos. El gilteritinib se toma por vía oral una vez al día durante los días 1 a 21 de cada ciclo de 21 días, y los ciclos se repiten si la enfermedad no progresa y los efectos secundarios son aceptables. El estudio analiza la seguridad, los efectos secundarios y la dosis más adecuada; no se indica una medida de resultado por separado.
who_for: Stage IV non-small cell lung cancer with an ALK fusion (adenocarcinoma, squamous, adenosquamous, or NOS)
Prior ALK inhibitor treatment, in one of three defined cohorts; later cohorts also need prior chemotherapy
Age 18 or older with ECOG performance status 0 to 2
Measurable disease per RECIST v1.1 on screening imaging
Blood counts, kidney, liver and albumin levels within the listed limits
not_for: Prior treatment with a FLT3 inhibitor
Active, symptomatic brain metastases or carcinomatous meningitis
Child-Pugh class C cirrhosis or untreated hepatitis B or C
Use of strong CYP3A inducers or certain P-gp drugs
Pregnancy, breastfeeding, or QTc over 480 ms
